title: Noodle Nine
tagline: Eat the numbers. Chain the bites. Fill the box.
teaser: A squishy, glowing noodle that only moves as fast as you dare. Gobble digits 1 to 9 to grow, bite again before you finish digesting to chain huge scores, and see if you can do what almost nobody did on a Berkeley terminal: fill the whole box.

manPage.synopsis: noodle nine — steer a growing noodle to the numbers; every bite while still digesting chains a bigger score.
manPage.description: Michael Toy wrote worm at UC Santa Cruz; its source carries the Regents’ copyright of 1980. You steer with the keys, the worm creeps on by itself between them, and its score quietly adds up all the growth still to come at every bite. Noodle Nine keeps those rules and makes the accident the game: chains, a tempo you set yourself, hand-made gardens and fill-the-box puzzles.

howToPlay: Steer with the arrow keys, W A S D or H J K L; left alone, the noodle creeps on by itself.
Eat a number to grow by it; bite again while still digesting to chain: each bite scores all the growth to come.
Mind the edge of the bed, the rocks and your own tail; Shift dashes; fill a whole box to win outright.
